facts.fact: The record, citing the World Bank status report of 25 October 2024, says the Cadastro Social Unico was still not operational as of mid-2024 and MASFAMU's SIGAS registry was available in all 54 CASIs in its place.

note: as_of is the document's own 2024-10-25 development-history date, not the event date, which it gives only as 'mid-2024'.
